thread:
alice: Heads-up — planning a branch cut and secret namespace rename for the staging -> prod promotion tomorrow morning. Need quick ✅ on TF change + k8s overlay wiring. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/merge/1234

ben: Reviewing now. Which service accounts are affected? any KMS key rotations bundled in this PR?

alice: Just the secret path rename from `secrets/staging/` -> `secrets/production/` and a k8s secret namespace remap in overlays. No KMS rotation. Affected svc-ids: inference-gw, metrics-forwarder.

carla: FYI the metrics-forwarder uses a projected volume with serviceAccount token; double-check RBAC bindings after namespace move. I can run a quick kubecheck after deploy.

dave: Can we gate this behind the shadow-canary config? propose 10% traffic to new namespace first, then 100% after 30m if no errors. Rollback plan?

alice: Rollback is to revert PR and reapply old overlay; I've added a fallback route mapping in the ingress to route traffic back to previous pods.

ben: Quick TF snippet from the PR for the rename — looks straightforward:
```
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "inference_api" {
  name = replace(var.secret_name, "staging", "production")
}
```
Make sure we also update tf state paths: `terraform state mv` will be required.

carla: Good catch. Also confirm any consumers reference the old path directly, e.g. `env.SSM_PATH` in apps. I found one in `runner-service` config. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR if needed.

infra-bot: Pipeline status: infra/secret-namespace-rename #1234 — plan complete, apply pending manual approval by @alice.

alice: Approving apply now. @dave please coordinate canary window and smoke checks (healthz, traces, token refresh).

dave: On it — I'll trigger canary and post results here. If anything >5% error rate in 15m we rollback. :thumbsup:

ben: After apply I'll run `terraform state list` and `kubectl get secrets -n production` to validate. Will post minimal logs if anything looks off.

carla: I'll run an RBAC diff: `kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:production:metrics-forwarder get pods` and report.

alice: Thanks team. Tagging seq: RFC 2026 for audit trail. Will update runbook with the manual `terraform state mv` step and the k8s secret remap command snippet.

dave: Canary started — all checks green so far (5m). Will update at 30m.

ben: state mv complete, secrets appear in prod namespace, no missing refs in infra plan.

carla: RBAC OK for metrics-forwarder. No extra bindings needed.

infra-bot: Apply successful. Canary at 10% -> 30m window in progress.

alice: Closing loop — looks good, promoting to full traffic after window. Thanks everyone. :party:
